wire.t: TJohn91 added Minnesota rookie receiver Tai Felton to The Champ late Wednesday night and dropped Malik Benson. Felton went straight to the taxi squad.

Baker Mayfield did not practice Wednesday with a foot injury, and Jalon Daniels took the first-team reps. Todd Bowles said Mayfield has made progress and Tampa Bay will decide on his availability Friday. Mayfield is on Catfan94’s Farm Team; Daniels is on StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte.

Colts at Texans tonight at 8:15 PM ET locks seven fantasy starters: C.J. Stroud for Jefferson’s Reserve, Jonathan Taylor for Kraft for Cash, Nico Collins for The Champ, David Montgomery for OBJAY, Daniel Jones for Asian Jim, and Emari Demercado and Tank Dell for Dude, Your Getting a Dell.
Marvin Harrison Jr. is Out for Thursday night after not practicing all week, and Woody Marks is Out. Harrison is on Jefferson’s Reserve's bench; Marks is on OBJAY, where David Montgomery starts.

Geno Smith was limited in Wednesday's walkthrough and said he intends to play Sunday. Brock Bowers didn't practice, but Kliff Kubiak said he doesn't need to practice this week to play. Kenneth Walker III did not practice, though Andy Reid said he's feeling a lot better.

Jaylen Waddle was a full participant Wednesday for Jefferson’s Reserve. Mike Evans did not practice. DeVonta Smith and T.J. Hockenson were limited for Catfan94’s Farm Team, and Jakobi Meyers was limited for StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte.

Kyler Murray did not practice and Minnesota is targeting a Week 12 return, so Asian Jim stays with Daniel Jones and Tyler Shough. Jake Ferguson is Out for Sunday for Kraft for Cash. Dalton Kincaid (OBJAY) and Darren Waller (Hold My DK) did not practice.

As of Thursday morning, StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte has five bye-week players in its Week 11 lineup, including Drake Maye at quarterback. Jefferson’s Reserve has two (Mack Hollins and Kyle Pitts Sr.) and I Chase Brown Kids has two (Bijan Robinson and Blake Corum).

stories.title: Seven starters lock tonight, Mayfield sat out Wednesday, and my lineup still has five guys on bye
stories.dek: Colts at Texans kicks off Week 11, Jalon Daniels got the Tampa Bay first-team reps, and StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte is somehow trending toward having a quarterback.
body: Colts at Texans is tonight at 8:15, and seven fantasy starters lock with it. C.J. Stroud goes for Jefferson’s Reserve, Jonathan Taylor for Kraft for Cash, Nico Collins for The Champ, David Montgomery for OBJAY and Daniel Jones for Asian Jim. Dude, Your Getting a Dell has two in the game, Emari Demercado and Tank Dell, which means Br0phy's week could be over before Friday. Marvin Harrison Jr. and Woody Marks are both Out, and neither was in a starting lineup, so nobody in this league gets burned by that one.

The news I actually care about: Baker Mayfield didn't practice Wednesday with the foot, and Jalon Daniels took the first-team reps. Todd Bowles said Mayfield is making progress and the Bucs will decide Friday. That's my $11 waiver add getting first-team reps. It's also bad news for nobody important, because Catfan94’s Farm Team is starting Brock Purdy at quarterback and Breece Hall at superflex anyway. jrsmith1391 loses nothing. I gain a starting quarterback. Everybody wins except Detroit's opponent.

Now the confession. As of this morning my lineup has Drake Maye at quarterback, who is Out and on bye, plus Zach Charbonnet, AJ Barner, Konata Mumpfield and Denzel Boston, who are all on bye. That's five zeroes in nine spots. Daniels and Justin Fields are on my bench. None of my guys play tonight, so I have until Sunday to fix it, and I will, but if you open the matchup tab right now The Champ is facing a lineup that looks like a protest.

Lines this morning: The Champ by 41.5 over me, down from 45.0 because Daniels looks like a starter. Jefferson’s Reserve by 20.5 over Bourbon Lover with Harrison Out and Mike Evans still not practicing. LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix stays at 38.5 because Bowers doesn't need practice to play. Over in waiver land, TJohn91 grabbed Tai Felton for the taxi squad and cut Malik Benson. The two-time champ is stashing rookies while I'm stashing bye weeks.

stories.title: Wednesday practice report: Walker sits, Waddle's full, Geno says he's playing
stories.dek: The first real practice reports of Week 11 are in. Here's what they mean for the six games in this league.
body: Catfan94’s Farm Team: Kenneth Walker III didn't practice, though Andy Reid said he's feeling a lot better, and he's in the starting lineup. DeVonta Smith and T.J. Hockenson were limited. That's why jrsmith1391 is down to a 26.5-point favorite over Asian Jim from 27.7.

Jefferson’s Reserve: Jaylen Waddle was a full participant, which is good. Marvin Harrison Jr. is Out tonight, and Mike Evans still didn't practice, which is not. jmello16 also has Mack Hollins and Kyle Pitts Sr. in the lineup with both on bye. Line down to 20.5 from 22.3.

OBJAY: Geno Smith was limited in a walkthrough and says he intends to play. Woody Marks is Out, Dalton Kincaid didn't practice, and Jaxson Dart is still on IR. Kraft for Cash is a 16.0-point favorite, down a point, and BTaylor1 already knows Jake Ferguson is Out.

Everybody else: Brock Bowers sat but doesn't need to practice to play, per Kliff Kubiak. Darren Waller didn't practice for Hold My DK, which matters roughly zero against a 77.0-point line. Kyler Murray is targeting Week 12, so Asian Jim rides Daniel Jones and Tyler Shough one more week. Friday's reports are the ones that count. Check them. Then check your lineup for bye weeks. Ask me how I know.

stories.title: Four weeks left: Kraft for Cash is 6‑4, and The Champ, Jefferson’s Reserve and Asian Jim are all 5‑5
stories.dek: Six teams make it. The top three are close to locked. The tiebreaker is points for, and TJohn91 has the most of the 5‑5 teams by a lot.
body: LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix and Hold My DK are 9‑1. Catfan94’s Farm Team is 7‑3. Those three are at least two games clear of seventh place with four weeks to play, so the real fight is for spots four through six between Kraft for Cash at 6‑4 and three teams at 5‑5.

Points for is the tiebreaker. Among the 5‑5 teams: The Champ 1414.72, Jefferson’s Reserve 1253.50, Asian Jim 1191.98. TJohn91 is 161.22 points ahead of jmello16 and 222.74 ahead of ManicOrientals, which is almost two full weeks of scoring. If it's a three-way tie at the end, the two-time champ is in.

I Chase Brown Kids (1219.86) and OBJAY (1184.34) are 4‑6, one game back. Bourbon Lover and StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte are 3‑7 and need four straight wins and some help. Dude, Your Getting a Dell is 0‑10 and mathematically eliminated: seven teams already have five wins, and Br0phy can finish with four at best.

This week's games that matter: Jefferson’s Reserve is a 22.3-point favorite over Bourbon Lover. Kraft for Cash is a 17.0-point favorite over OBJAY now that Geno Smith is Questionable. Catfan94’s Farm Team is a 27.7-point favorite over Asian Jim, with Smith-Njigba on bye. And The Champ gets me, a team whose quarterback depends on Baker Mayfield's ankle, so pencil TJohn91 in for 6‑5.

stories.title: Week 10: Hold My DK beats me by 117.42, Asian Jim steals Monday night, and Dude, Your Getting a Dell is 0‑10
stories.dek: Two teams are 9‑1, four teams are fighting over three playoff spots, and I'm 3‑7 with no quarterback for Week 11.
body: Hold My DK 196.34, StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte 78.92. That's a 117.42-point margin, the biggest of the week and the second-biggest of the season behind Catfan94's 127.22 in Week 5. Christian McCaffrey had 50.3, Patrick Mahomes 45.92, and Derrick Henry added 16.5 on Monday night with two touchdowns on 10 yards rushing. Chuba Hubbard scored 35.7 on the bench. TheMoneyTeam2302 is 9‑1 and has scored 1582.92 points.

The game of the week happened Monday. Kraft for Cash led Asian Jim 89.30 to 84.06 going into Chargers at Ravens, and BTaylor1 had Zay Flowers left against three for ManicOrientals. Flowers scored 9.9. Omarion Hampton ran for 105 yards and a touchdown for 19.0, Tre' Harris caught five for 86 (12.6) and Justice Hill added 7.8. Final: Asian Jim 123.46, Kraft for Cash 99.20. ManicOrientals pulled Ladd McConkey for Harris before kickoff, and that move is worth a win. Asian Jim has won three straight and is 5‑5.

LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix beat Jefferson’s Reserve 232.54 to 134.62, the second-highest score in league history, and is 9‑1 with six straight wins. The Champ beat Dude, Your Getting a Dell 166.08 to 68.10; Jacoby Brissett threw for 340 yards and scored 12.3, and Br0phy is 0‑10. Catfan94’s Farm Team beat OBJAY 138.94 to 83.62, and I Chase Brown Kids beat Bourbon Lover 124.46 to 116.92 in the closest game of the week.

Bad beat: Jefferson’s Reserve scored 134.62, the fifth-highest score of the week, and lost by 97.92. Low score: Dude, Your Getting a Dell at 68.10. And for the record, I scored 78.92 and started AJ Barner at superflex while Dalton Schultz (8.1) and Samaje Perine (13.9) sat on my bench. Swap those two in and I score 93.12 and lose by 103.22 instead of 117.42. Still the worst week of anyone not named Br0phy.

columnists.name: Hugh G. Rection
columnists.bio: Has never once lowered his voice. Writes from a basement shrine to Boston sports in pajama pants, fueled by Dunkin'. Believes every 4-2 team is either a dynasty or a disgrace.

columnists.bio: Finished 14th in a 12-team league once. Nobody knows how. Files his columns from the porch of a trailer with a laptop he calls 'the press credential' and gives advice anyway.

columns.title: THURSDAY NIGHT!! COLTS!! TEXANS!! SEVEN STARTERS!! FIVE BYES!!
columns.dek: Hugh G. Rection has the Week 11 opener circled, starred and underlined on the shrine calendar.
body: SEVEN STARTERS LOCK TONIGHT! STROUD! JONATHAN TAYLOR! NICO COLLINS! DAVID MONTGOMERY! DANIEL JONES! AND Dude, Your Getting a Dell HAS TWO GUYS IN IT! EMARI DEMERCADO AND TANK DELL! Br0phy COULD BE DONE FOR THE WEEK BY 11:30 PM THURSDAY! A 77.0-POINT DOG WITH NOTHING LEFT FOR SUNDAY! I RESPECT IT! I DON'T UNDERSTAND IT BUT I RESPECT IT!

AND THE GUY WHO RUNS THIS WEBSITE! FIVE BYE-WEEK PLAYERS IN HIS LINEUP! DRAKE MAYE! ZACH CHARBONNET! AJ BARNER! KONATA MUMPFIELD! DENZEL BOSTON! THAT'S NOT A LINEUP, THAT'S A LIST OF GUYS WHO ARE HOME ON THE COUCH! HE HAS UNTIL SUNDAY! HE SAYS HE'LL FIX IT! I'VE HEARD THAT BEFORE! I'VE SAID THAT BEFORE ABOUT MY BASEMENT!

BUT JALON DANIELS TOOK THE FIRST-TEAM REPS! THE $11 MAN! THE LINE WENT FROM 45.0 TO 41.5! THAT'S 3.5 POINTS OF HOPE! The Champ IS STILL GONNA WIN BY FORTY! BUT FORTY IS LESS THAN FORTY-FIVE AND IN THIS HOUSE WE CELEBRATE PROGRESS! I SPILLED THE DUNKIN'! AGAIN!

columns.title: Bill_Buttlicker didn't fix his quarterback problem. He bought a raffle ticket.
columns.dek: Richard "Dick" Gozinya has seen lottery tickets with better odds than an $11 backup who needs someone else's ankle to cooperate.
body: I'll give the man this: dropping Marquise Brown was right. Brown isn't on an NFL team. You can't play a guy who doesn't have a locker. That's the one thing in this transaction I'd sign off on.

Everything else is hope dressed up as strategy. Jalon Daniels starts for Tampa Bay only if Baker Mayfield's foot and ankle keep him out against Detroit. Daniels went 1-2 in three starts earlier this year. Bill_Buttlicker is 3‑7, a 45.0-point underdog, and his quarterback plan depends on another manager's quarterback getting worse. When I played, we didn't pray for the other guy to pull a hamstring. We hit him until he did. Fantasy-wise, I mean.

Meanwhile, Bill_Buttlicker owns 12 first-round picks over the next three drafts and has 28 losses all time. That's the real move. Stop paying $11 for Sunday and start packaging picks for a quarterback who'll be in the lineup in 2027. You're not contending. Act like it. Toughen up.

columns.title: 5 Thursday-night lineup tips from Holden McGroin, who once locked in a kicker on Wednesday for 'momentum'
columns.dek: Colts at Texans is tonight. Holden McGroin has opinions about it, and every one of them is wrong.
body: 1. Bench everyone playing tonight. Thursday players are tired from playing on short rest. Start the bye-week guys instead. They've had two weeks off. That's double rest, which my math says is double points.

2. Bill_Buttlicker has five bye-week players in his lineup. Leave them there. When the rest of the league zigs, you zag, and when you zag hard enough you finish 3‑7. That's not my opinion. That's his record.

3. Jalon Daniels took the first-team reps for Tampa Bay, so obviously bench him. First-team reps on Wednesday means he peaked too early. You want a quarterback who's saving it for Sunday, like Drake Maye, who is saving it for next week.
4. Br0phy should start Emari Demercado and Tank Dell tonight, then pick up two more Texans and start them too. If you're going to lose by 77.0, lose with team chemistry.

5. jmello16 has Mack Hollins and Kyle Pitts Sr. on bye in his lineup and is still a 20.5-point favorite. That tells me byes don't matter. I've been saying this since the season I finished 14th in a 12-team league, and nobody has ever proved me wrong, mostly because nobody asks.

columns.title: Hold My DK spent $87 of FAAB and has 87 all-play wins. My spreadsheet calls this proof.
columns.dek: Ivana Humpalot ran the waiver numbers and found a correlation that is absolutely not a coincidence, according to her.
body: League-wide, managers have spent $445 of $1,200 in FAAB this year. TheMoneyTeam2302 has spent $87 and Hold My DK's all-play record is 87-23. That's a 1.00 FAAB-to-all-play-win ratio, the purest number in this league. I've named it the Money Constant.

Catfan94 has spent $81 and has 95 all-play wins, a ratio of 1.17, meaning every FAAB dollar is worth 1.17 wins. TJohn91 spent $80 and has 68, so each dollar of The Champ's is worth 0.85 wins. My conclusion: TJohn91 has been overpaying by 15%, and as a two-time champion he should know better.

Then there's jmello16, who has spent $0 and has 54 all-play wins. That's an infinite ratio. My spreadsheet returned #DIV/0!, which I'm treating as 'the best value in league history.' Br0phy spent $11 total and has 5 all-play wins, 0.45 per dollar. Bill_Buttlicker has spent $17 for 28, which is 1.65 per dollar, better than Catfan94's 1.17. He asked me to put that in bold. I did not, because he's 3‑7.

exits.t: Scored 8.1 on the StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte bench while AJ Barner, another tight end, started at superflex and scored 5.9. Wants to go somewhere the owner can count to nine.
Scored 14.9 on the I Chase Brown Kids bench while Javonte Williams started and scored 8.2. Would like to be traded to a team with fewer quarterbacks and more lineup spots for him.
Scored 15.7 on the Asian Jim bench while Austin Ekeler (9.2) and Justice Hill (7.8) started. Asian Jim won anyway, which McGowan considers beside the point.
Scored 9.4 on the Bourbon Lover bench while Demarcus Robinson (0.0) and Keon Coleman (2.1) started. Bourbon Lover lost by 7.54. Jeudy has done the math.

Scored 14.2 on the Catfan94’s Farm Team taxi squad in Week 10 while Zonovan Knight started at flex and scored 2.4. jrsmith1391 has since cut Knight and picked up Myles Price instead of promoting Cameron. Cameron noticed.
Scored 12.4 on the Jefferson’s Reserve taxi squad while Chris Olave started and scored 6.0. Jefferson’s Reserve lost by 97.92, so it didn't matter, but he'd still like to be asked.

facts: TJohn91 has won both titles on Sleeper. He went 12-2 in 2024 and 10-4 in 2025.
Bill_Buttlicker owns 12 first-round picks over the next three drafts, the most in the league. JAY2913 is next with six.
Catfan94's 243.58 in Week 5 this year is the highest score in league history, and his 232.54 in Week 10 is second. Nobody else has topped 198.64.
Bill_Buttlicker went 3-11 in 2024 and 4-10 in 2025, scored 54.86 in 2024 Week 3, the second-lowest score in league history, and is 10-28 all time.
Br0phy's 39.26 in Week 8 this year is the lowest score in league history by 14.78 points. Dude, Your Getting a Dell is 0-10.
